meta.title: Snowflake Data & AI Services
meta.description: Snowflake data and AI services: strategy, migration, engineering, analytics, and AI agents. Snowflake Premier Partner, nearshore delivery across the Americas.

hero.title: Snowflake data and AI services, from strategy to the <hl>agentic enterprise</hl>.
hero.description: Strategy, engineering, and enablement under one accountable team, building two capabilities that stay in-house: a data practice decisions can trust and an AI practice that ships to production, across THINK, BUILD, and GROW.

THINK.intro: Set the direction. We work inside the team to pinpoint where data and AI create real value, then sequence a roadmap the business can execute, grounded in what the data can support today.

BUILD.intro: Make it real. We build it alongside the team: the governed foundation on Snowflake that AI actually needs, then the pipelines, models, and agents that run on it, integrated with the systems the business runs on.

GROW.intro: Compound the value. The team scales AI use cases and agents into production with our people alongside, and keeps improving them, with Viewnear on hand for as long as that is useful, including as a managed service.

agentic.title: Ready for <hl>agents that act</hl>.
agentic.intro: An AI practice ready for agents does not start with agents. It starts with governed data and trusted context: one layer where data, business context, models, and workflows come together. We build that layer with the team, so when the agents act, they act on numbers the business trusts.
agentic.proofLine: See the AI we put into production in our <cases>case studies</cases>, and how we pick the model for each job on <dataai>data & AI</dataai>.

impact.title: What changes, and when
impact.intro: A practical view of the value an engagement returns: by horizon, not by feature list, with the targets we agree up front.

phases.title: Foundations & first value
phases.body: A governed Snowflake foundation stood up, priority data flowing, and the first production dashboards live: value from sprint one, not after a year-long build.

phases.title: Scale & self-service
phases.body: Analytics and AI use cases rolled out across teams, self-service adopted, and manual reporting retired: decisions run on current, trusted numbers.

phases.title: Compounding advantage
phases.body: New use cases shipped in weeks, run cost tuned, and a team fluent enough to keep extending it on their own: data and AI become a durable competitive edge.

run.title: Delivery leaders can govern
run.intro: We de-risk the engagement itself (clear timelines, steering, and documentation that ships with the build) so the buy is as low-risk as the outcome is valuable.

phases.label: Timeline
phases.title: A fixed 8–16 week arc
phases.body: An initial build is scoped to reach production in 8–16 weeks: a discovery fixes scope and price up front, and every sprint closes with working software, so value lands from sprint one.

phases.label: Steering
phases.title: Steering & transparency
phases.body: Regular steering reviews, a shared backlog, and clear decision gates keep sponsors in control of scope, budget, and priorities throughout.

phases.label: Proof
phases.title: De-risked by design
phases.body: We prove the approach with a focused proof of concept before the full build, so the commitment to scale rests on evidence, not a slide deck.

phases.label: Run
phases.title: Documented, then kept improving
phases.body: Documentation and runbooks ship with the build. From there the team runs it, or Viewnear keeps running and improving it as a managed service.

run.securityLine: Security and governance are built into every phase: <link>see how we keep enterprise data safe</link>.

stack.title: Why we build Snowflake-native
stack.intro: Openflow to Horizon Catalog to Cortex: we lead with Snowflake-native products over third-party tools, so there is one governed copy of the data, one lineage to audit, and one trusted context every AI agent relies on. dbt is the one external framework we run, natively against Snowflake.

engagement.title: Engagement models
engagement.intro: Flexible ways to partner with us, matched to the shape of the problem, from a fixed-scope build to an embedded team or an ongoing managed service. Whichever model fits, the way we deliver doesn't change.

models.title: Fixed cost
models.body: A defined scope, timeline, and price agreed up front: fixed-outcome delivery, priced to the result rather than the hours. Best when the outcome is clear and budget certainty matters from day one.
models.how: We scope the work in a short, discovery, then commit to a price and a date.

models.title: Time & materials
models.body: Flexible, iterative delivery billed by effort against a shared backlog. Ideal for evolving requirements and discovery-led work.
models.how: We deliver sprint to sprint against a prioritized backlog the business controls.

models.title: Dedicated team & staff augmentation
models.body: Embed our certified practitioners alongside the in-house team, as a dedicated team or a team extension. We accelerate delivery while leveling up their capability.
models.how: SnowPro-certified engineers join the team, its tools, and its ways of working.

models.title: Managed services & support
models.body: Ongoing run, optimization, and enhancement once the practice is live, so it keeps compounding while the in-house team grows into it.
models.how: A retained team monitors, tunes cost and performance, and ships enhancements.
models.bestFor: Running & growing a live Snowflake estate

panel.title: The model flexes. The standard doesn’t.
panel.body: However an organization chooses to engage, every Viewnear engagement is delivered to the same standard: the things that make the difference between a build that ships and one that stalls.

value.title: One certified team, with depth at every level
value.body: One accountable team: the people who scope the work are the ones who deliver it.

value.title: Verified Snowflake depth
value.body: SnowPro-certified engineers with a verified Snowflake delivery record behind every decision, from strategy through production.

value.title: Priced to outcomes
value.body: Scope and price agreed up front, whichever model fits.

value.title: Governance built in
value.body: Security, lineage, and access control designed in from the first table, not bolted on.

value.title: Documented and kept improving
value.body: Documentation and enablement ship with the build, and Viewnear can keep running and improving it as a managed service.

value.title: Integrated with the enterprise
value.body: Data products that connect to and from the systems the business runs on: ERP, CRM, and customer-facing apps.

cost.body: Engagements are scoped on data volume and source complexity, the number of analytics and AI use cases, team size, and timeline. We agree scope and price up front (whichever model fits) so there are no surprises.

footer.note: Not sure which model fits? Tell us the problem and we’ll recommend one.
